entrance_antiphon.latin: Ad te levavi animam meam, Deus meus, in te confido, non erubescam. Neque irrideant me inimici mei, etenim universi qui te exspectant non confundentur.
entrance_antiphon.english: To you, I lift up my soul, O my God. In you, I have trusted; let me not be put to shame. Nor let my enemies exult over me; and let none who hope in you be put to shame.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dominus dabit benignitatem, et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord will bestow his bounty, and our earth shall yield its increase.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Audite verbum Domini, gentes, et annuntiate illud in finibus terrae: Ecce Salvator noster adveniet, et iam nolite timere.
entrance_antiphon.english: Hear the word of the Lord, O nations; declare it to the distant lands: Behold, our Savior will come; you need no longer fear.

communion_antiphon.latin: Veni, Domine, visitare nos in pace, ut laetemur coram te corde perfecto.
communion_antiphon.english: Come, O Lord, visit us in peace, that we may rejoice before you with a blameless heart.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ecce Dominus veniet, et omnes sancti eius cum eo; et erit in die illa lux magna.
entrance_antiphon.english: Behold, the Lord will come, and all his holy ones with him; and on that day there will be a great light.

communion_antiphon.latin: Coronam iustitiae reddet iustus iudex iis qui diligunt adventum eius.
communion_antiphon.english: The Just Judge will bestow a crown of righteousness on those who eagerly await his coming.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Veniet Dominus et non tardabit, et illuminabit abscondita tenebrarum, et manifestabit se ad omnes gentes.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord will come and he will not delay. He will illumine what is hidden in darkness and reveal himself to all the nations.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce Dominus noster cum virtute veniet, ut illuminet oculos servorum suorum.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, our Lord will come with power and will enlighten the eyes of his servants.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Prope es tu, Domine, et omnes viae tuae veritas; initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis, quia in aeternum tu es.
entrance_antiphon.english: You, O Lord, are close, and all your ways are truth. From of old I have known of your decrees, for you are eternal.

communion_antiphon.latin: Iuste et pie vivamus in hoc saeculo, exspectantes beatam spem et adventum gloriae magni Dei.
communion_antiphon.english: Let us live justly and devoutly in this age, as we await the blessed hope and the coming of the glory of our great God.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ecce Dominus veniet cum splendore descendens visitare populum suum in pace, et constituere super eum vitam sempiternam.
entrance_antiphon.english: Behold, the Lord will come descending with splendor to visit his people with peace, and he will bestow on them eternal life.

communion_antiphon.latin: Salvatorem exspectamus Dominum Iesum Christum, qui reformabit corpus humilitatis nostrae, configuratum corpori claritatis suae.
communion_antiphon.english: We await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, who will change our mortal bodies, to conform with his glorified body.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Veni, et ostende nobis faciem tuam, Domine, qui sedes super Cherubim, et salvi erimus.
entrance_antiphon.english: Come and show us your face, O Lord, who are seated upon the Cherubim, and we will be saved.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce venio cito et merces mea mecum est, dicit Dominus, dare unicuique secundum opera sua.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, I am coming soon and my recompense is with me, says the Lord, to bestow a reward according to the deeds of each.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Populus Sion, ecce Dominus veniet ad salvandas gentes; et auditam faciet Dominus gloriam vocis suae in laetitia cordis vestri.
entrance_antiphon.english: O people of Sion, behold, the Lord will come to save the nations, and the Lord will make the glory of his voice heard in the joy of your heart.

communion_antiphon.latin: Placare, Domine, quaesumus, nostrae precibus humilitatis et hostiis, et, ubi nulla suppetunt suffragia meritorum, tuae nobis indulgentiae succurre praesidiis.
communion_antiphon.english: Jerusalem, arise and stand upon the heights, and behold the joy which comes to you from God.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Audite verbum Domini, gentes, et annuntiate illud in finibus terrae: Ecce Salvator noster adveniet, et iam nolite timere.

communion_antiphon.english: Behold, I am coming soon and my recompense is with me, says the Lord, to bestow a reward according to the deeds of each.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Gaudete in Domino semper: iterum dico, gaudete. Dominus enim prope est.
entrance_antiphon.english: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I say, rejoice. Indeed, the Lord is near.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dicite: Pusillanimes, confortamini et nolite timere: ecce Deus noster veniet et salvabit nos.
communion_antiphon.english: Say to the faint of heart: Be strong and do not fear. Behold, our God will come, and he will save us.

entrance_antiphon.english: Hear the word of the Lord, O nations; declare it to the distant lands: Behold, our Savior will come; you need no longer fear.

communion_antiphon.english: Come, O Lord, visit us in peace, that we may rejoice before you with a blameless heart.

entrance_antiphon.english: Behold, the Lord will come, and all his holy ones with him; and on that day there will be a great light.

communion_antiphon.english: Behold, our Lord will come with power and will enlighten the eyes of his servants.

entrance_antiphon.english: You, O Lord, are close, and all your ways are truth. From of old I have known of your decrees, for you are eternal.

communion_antiphon.english: Let us live justly and devoutly in this age, as we await the blessed hope and the coming of the glory of our great God.

entrance_antiphon.english: Behold, the Lord will come descending with splendor to visit his people with peace, and he will bestow on them eternal life.

communion_antiphon.latin: Salvatorem exspectamus Dominum Iesum Christum, qui reformabit corpus humilitatis nostrae, configuratum corpori claritatis suae.
communion_antiphon.english: We await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, who will change our mortal bodies, to conform with his glorified body.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Rorate, caeli, desuper, et nubes pluant iustum; aperiatur terra et germinet Salvatorem.
entrance_antiphon.english: Drop down dew from above, you heavens, and let the clouds rain down the Just One; let the earth be opened and bring forth a Savior.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce Virgo concipiet, et pariet filium; et vocabitur nomen eius Emmanuel.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, a Virgin shall conceive and bear a son; and his name will be called Emmanuel.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Laetentur caeli et exsultet terra, quia Dominus noster veniet, et pauperum suorum miserebitur.
entrance_antiphon.english: Rejoice, O heavens, and exult, O earth, for our Lord will come to show mercy to his poor.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce veniet desideratus cunctis gentibus, et replebitur gloria domus Domini.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, the Desired of all the nations will come, and the house of the Lord will be filled with glory.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Rex noster adveniet Christus, quem Ioannes praedicavit Agnum esse venturum.
entrance_antiphon.english: Christ our King is coming, he is the Lamb foretold by John.

communion_antiphon.latin: Vocabunt nomen eius Emmanuel, quod est interpretatum Nobiscum-Deus.
communion_antiphon.english: His name will be called Emmanuel, which means God-with-us.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Qui venturus est veniet et non tardabit, et iam non erit timor in finibus nostris, quoniam ipse est Salvator noster.
entrance_antiphon.english: He who is to come will come and will not delay, and now there will be no fear within our land, for he is our Savior.

communion_antiphon.latin: Visitabit nos Oriens ex alto, ad dirigendos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
communion_antiphon.english: The Dawn from on high will visit us, guiding our feet in the way of peace.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Egredietur virga de radice Iesse, et replebitur omnis terra gloria Domini, et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei.
entrance_antiphon.english: A branch shall sprout from the root of Jesse, and the glory of the Lord will fill the whole earth, and all flesh will see the salvation of God.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dixit Angelus ad Mariam: Ecce concipies et paries filium, et vocabis nomen eius Iesum.
communion_antiphon.english: The Angel said to Mary: Behold, you will conceive and bear a son, and you shall name him Jesus.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Modo veniet Dominator Dominus, et vocabitur nomen eius Emmanuel, quia Nobiscum-Deus.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord and Ruler will be coming soon, and his name will called be Emmanuel, because he will be called God-with-us.

communion_antiphon.latin: Beata quae credidisti, quoniam perficientur ea quae dicta sunt tibi a Domino.
communion_antiphon.english: Blessed are you who have believed, that what was spoken to you by the Lord would be fulfilled.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Attollite, portae, capita vestra, et elevamini, portae aeternales, et introibit rex gloriae.
entrance_antiphon.english: O gates, lift high your heads; grow higher, ancient doors. Let him enter, the king of glory!

communion_antiphon.latin: Magnificat anima mea Dominum, quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est.
communion_antiphon.english: My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord, for the Almighty has done great things for me.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Nascetur nobis parvulus, et vocabitur Deus, Fortis; in ipso benedicentur omnes tribus terrae.
entrance_antiphon.english: A child shall be born for us, and he will be called God, the Almighty; every tribe of the earth shall be blest in him.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce sto ad ostium et pulso: si quis audierit vocem meam, et aperuerit mihi ianuam, intrabo ad illum, et cenabo cum illo, et ipse mecum.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if anyone hears my voice and opens the door to me, I will enter his house and dine with him, and he with me.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ecce iam venit plenitudo temporis, in quo misit Deus Filium suum in terram.
entrance_antiphon.english: Behold, when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son into the world.

communion_antiphon.latin: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israel, quia visitavit et fecit redemptionem plebis suae.
communion_antiphon.english: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel! He has visited his people and redeemed them.
